title: Bolt.new vs Base44: Which AI Builder Should You Use? (2026)
summary: Bolt builds browser prototypes. Base44 handles internal tools. For a production app with database, auth, and deploy all included — here's the third option.
body_markdown: Base44 is more beginner-friendly — no file structures, no token management, no code required. Bolt assumes some technical comfort with file systems and frameworks. For complete beginners who want a shipped product,[Blink](https://blink.new/) handles the full stack automatically — no developer experience needed, and no credit system to manage before building something real.
